name: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
summary: A bucket refills one token at a time; each request spends one, and a request is rejected when it runs dry.
bestFor: Explaining rate limiting and traffic shaping to developers
prompt: Explain how a token bucket rate limiter works. Show a bucket that refills with tokens at a steady rate, requests that each spend one token to get through, and what happens when a burst empties the bucket and the next request is rejected. End on why this smooths traffic while still allowing short bursts.
